scripts.build: npm run vendor && tailwindcss -i assets/css/app.css -o static/css/app.css --minify
scripts.watch: npm run vendor && tailwindcss -i assets/css/app.css -o static/css/app.css --watch=always
scripts.vendor: mkdir -p static/js && cp node_modules/htmx.org/dist/htmx.min.js static/js/htmx.min.js && cp node_modules/alpinejs/dist/cdn.min.js static/js/alpine.min.js
